spans.s: ग्लस् vt. 1Ā (pp. ग्लस्त; pres. ग्लसते) To eat.
ग्लह् vt. 1P, 10U (pres. ग्लहति, ग्लाहयति-ते) 1. To gamble, to win by gambling; 2. to take, to receive.
ग्लह m. 1. A dice-player; 2. a stake, a wager, a bet; 3. a die; 4. gambling, playing.
ग्लान a. (f. ना) Weary, languid, exhausted, sick, fatigued.
ग्लान a. (f. ना) Weary, languid, exhausted, sick, fatigued.
ग्लानि f. 1. Exhaustion, fatigue, हरति सुरतग्लानिमंगानुकूलः शिप्रावातः Megh.i.31, Sant.S.iv.4; 2. debility, sickness, weakness; 3. decay, decline, यदा यदा हि धर्मस्य ग्लानिर्भवति भारत Bg.iv.7.
